press.description: BitTasker is revolutionizing how taskers and taskees connect, work, and get paid through Bitcoin-powered secure payment contracts.

about.title: About BitTasker
about.description: BitTasker is a revolutionary gig economy platform that connects individuals and businesses with skilled professionals for a wide range of tasks. By integrating Bitcoin for fast, secure, and low-cost payments, and leveraging decentralized technologies like Nostr for identity, BitTasker is building a more open, global, and equitable marketplace for services.

inquiries.title: Media Inquiries
